title: HappEats Dry Fruits & Healthy Snacks
headline: A joyful, scalable packaging architecture for healthy snack retail.
description: HappEats committed to delivering the finest quality healthy snacks with a touch of joy. AFTER THAT engineered a complete FMCG visual identity and packaging system featuring a smile-shaped brand mark, custom wave-like leaf vector illustrations, and a color-coded SKU architecture across almonds, cashews, pistachios, raisins, and seed mixes.
challenge: Create a premium, scalable packaging system for a diverse dry fruits range that improves retail shelf visibility, communicates ingredient purity, and maintains unmistakable brand recall across both 100gm pouches and 25gm grab-and-go packs.
approach: We instituted a product-first packaging hierarchy using vibrant Pantone purple accented with distinct SKU colors (crimson for almonds, emerald for cashews, fresh green for pistachios). We paired this with custom dry fruit doodles and transparent see-through windows, accompanied by full-scale delivery vehicle fleet branding and retail cartons.
deliverables: Commercial Delivery Vehicle & Truck Fleet Branding

clientBackground: HappEats is a fast-scaling healthy snack brand dedicated to delivering premium, bio-sourced dry fruits and wholesome nutrition across South India retail networks. The brand seeks to bridge everyday snacking indulgence with functional health benefits.
strategicApproach: We formulated a product-first, joy-anchored packaging hierarchy. By coupling an unmistakable smiling monogram mark with an intuitive, color-coded Pantone architecture, we established immediate distinction between almonds, cashews, pistachios, raisins, and seed mixes.
creativeDirection: Maximalist FMCG vibrancy grounded in clean information design. A rich royal purple foundation accentuated by variant-specific punch colors, paired with custom organic leaf-wave vector illustrations and precision-engineered transparent product freshness windows.
executionProcess: From 2D structural die-cut drafting to 3D pouch renders, carton box wholesale systems, luxury gifting boxes, and high-visibility logistics fleet vehicle wraps across commercial delivery trucks.
visualIdentityApplications: Corrugated Master Cartons & Wholesale Shipper Boxes
Supermarket Gondola End-Cap Displays & Shelf Strips
outcomes: Standardized packaging production across 5 primary dry fruit lines, resulting in a verified multi-state retail rollout across Kerala and Tamil Nadu with a 40% reduction in packaging production turnaround time.

title: DIZZIRE SILK AND SAREES
headline: ELEGANCE WOVEN INTO EVERY THREAD.
description: A contemporary fashion identity inspired by the elegance of Indian silk, combining distinctive visual symbolism, editorial campaign imagery and retail applications.
challenge: Modernise a respected heritage silk and bridal saree destination with a modern, elegant visual identity that competes with national luxury fashion houses while honouring traditional handloom motifs.
approach: We created the bespoke 'DI' desire-star identity embodying fluid silk draping and customer aspirations. The identity is supported by an opulent color system of imperial red, warm champagne gold, light beige, and deep maroon, paired with Cormorant and Montserrat typography, luxury carry bags, outdoor billboards, and retail architectural concepts.
deliverables: Master Brand Identity & Desire Star Monogram
6-Tone Color System (Primary Red, Light Beige, Champagne Gold, Maroon)
Luxury Embossed Shopping Carry Bag Suite

clientBackground: Dizzire Silk and Sarees is an established bridal luxury textile destination in Kothamangalam, Kerala, specializing in hand-woven bridal Kanchipuram silks, designer wedding sarees, and generational heirloom weaves.
strategicApproach: Positioning Dizzire as an authoritative bridal fashion empire rather than a regional boutique. Under the strategic positioning "Elegance Woven Into Every Thread", we created an elevated brand ecosystem uniting regal South Indian handloom prestige with contemporary international luxury aesthetics.
creativeDirection: Editorial minimalism meets imperial bridal grandeur. A stark monochromatic black, white, and imperial crimson (#F20D18) palette accented with metallic gold foil stamping, paired with high-fashion model cinematography, architectural typography, and bespoke Malayalam and English typography.
executionProcess: Engineered a comprehensive 11-chapter brand identity system spanning primary and secondary logo marks, minimum clear-space parameters, bilingual type hierarchies, packaging structural die-lines, foil-stamped carry bags, staff uniforms, architectural storefront glow signage, and high-impact outdoor billboards.
visualIdentityApplications: Luxury Heavy-GSM Matte & Gold Carry Bags
Architectural Storefront Facade & 3D LED Glow Signage
Staff Apparel, Name Badges & Collateral Suite
outcomes: Successfully transformed Dizzire into Kothamangalam's leading bridal landmark, driving record showroom footfall for peak wedding seasons and commanding immediate brand authority across Central Kerala.

title: KAKAPO
headline: A visual exploration of fashion identity, typography, creative direction and clothing applications.
description: A collection of visual explorations for KAKAPO, bringing together distinctive logo concepts, typography, fashion imagery, colour, clothing applications and packaging.
challenge: Explore diverse creative directions, typographic systems, and fashion styling for contemporary streetwear without confining the brand to a single conventional aesthetic.
approach: We developed a 5-chapter visual study exploring raw brush feather lettering, aerodynamic flight silhouettes, modular stacked lowercase lockups, oversized monograms, and a 7-color botanical palette translated into garments and physical retail packaging.
deliverables: Woven Damask Hem Labels & Satin Care Tags
FSC Kraft Monogram Shopping Bags & Lightbox Signage

clientBackground: KAKAPO is an independent contemporary fashion and streetwear label exploring form, structural silhouette tailoring, and the intersection between raw urban subculture and refined craftsmanship.
strategicApproach: "A Study in Creative Expression." Rather than adopting generic streetwear tropes, we developed a deconstructive visual language anchored by brutalist typography, asymmetrical composition, and raw textural tactility that speaks to discerning fashion innovators.
creativeDirection: Brutalist minimalism with industrial grit. Monochromatic high-contrast typography, bone-white canvas backgrounds, stark black vector marks, heavy-GSM hang tags, and high-fashion editorial lookbook art direction.
executionProcess: From identity ideation to technical embroidery tape specs, custom jacquard woven label engineering, metal hardware engraving blueprints, lookbook art direction, and digital motion lookbooks.
visualIdentityApplications: Heavy-GSM Embossed Garment Hang Tags & Cord Locks
Jacquard Woven Neck Labels & Care Tags
outcomes: Created a highly magnetic, recognizable streetwear identity with immediate subcultural credibility and seamless scalability across global apparel production lines.

title: Milli Flame Parisian Dining & Café
headline: Petite Flamme. Grand Goût. — Understated luxury in modern Parisian dining.
description: A distinctive restaurant identity built around a circular flame emblem, contemporary typography and a vibrant visual system. From food imagery and takeaway packaging to uniforms, stationery and storefront applications, the creative direction extends across the complete dining experience.
challenge: Establish a distinct Parisian bistro identity balancing modern culinary simplicity with quiet luxury, approachable elegance, and memorable takeaway coffee and dining collateral.
approach: We designed an organic flame silhouette nestled inside a minimalist circular badge with the French motto 'Petite Flamme. Grand Goût.'. The color system pairs fresh turquoise cyan with quetzal green and warm gold accents, supported by Nexa and Montserrat typography across menus, aprons, coffee cups, and mobile interfaces.
deliverables: Color Palette (Tropical Cyan, Quetzal Green, True Gold)

images.caption: Modern Parisian dining interior and circular flame emblem
Golden croissants on craft bakery paper with circular brand seal

clientBackground: Milli Flame is an artisanal Parisian bistro and patisserie concept uniting the smoky soul of wood-fired European cuisine with delicate morning viennoiserie, bespoke coffee craft, and an evening natural wine bar.
strategicApproach: Harmonizing classic French gastronomic romance with bold, modern bistro energy. We built the brand narrative around "The Warmth of Parisian Gastronomy", crafting a sensory identity that feels rooted in heritage yet vibrant enough to capture modern diners.
creativeDirection: Warm ember copper tones, refined French bistro typography, tactile embossed paper stocks, and copper-foiled leather menu jackets. An atmosphere of timeless Parisian warmth and culinary mastery.
executionProcess: Full-scale hospitality identity system: from flame monogram engineering and bilingual French-English menu typography to packaging for takeaway viennoiserie, exterior projecting brass signage, bespoke coasters, and linen staff aprons.
visualIdentityApplications: Takeaway Espresso Cups & Embossed Pastry Boxes
Custom Debossed Drink Coasters & Table Runners
Projecting Brass Exterior Signage & Window Decals
outcomes: Engineered a turn-key European hospitality branding suite ready for high-end flagship restaurant launch, establishing an instantly warm, prestigious dining identity.
